description: Proxy products with packs and prices, cheapest first. Each pack has an offer_id and locations.countries containing its confirmed two-letter target countries. An unavailable list does not establish country support. Prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria; pass currency to choose.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN. By default prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira inside Nigeria, from where the request comes from.

name: list_proxy_products
